This document out outlines 
 the minor maintenance procedure as indicated by P1 in the above title 
 block for the manual 
 gate valve depending on external / internal leakage
This valve can be used in lines at any position.

The first 
 draft initiated and tested by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni at 27 Dec 2003, 
 accepted by General Director eng. Saad Mostafa, revised by EDEPCo. eng.. Samir 
 Abdel-Gelil, and approved by eng. Awad Mohammed Fathy Soliman Head 
 Sector of Talkha power station.

Work order 
 must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area.
Wear safety Helmet, belt, shoes, .... etc

Drain the pipeline, which connected to this 
 valve.

Drain the pipeline, which connected to this 
 valve.
Suitable lifting device.

Check any leakage from valve gland. If it 
 found, retighten on gland bolts.

Check any leakage from the pressure tight 
 cover. If it found retighten the cover nut.

Check any leakage from flange end for flange 
 type

Be sure the valve was out of operation and the 
 pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two 
 end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.

items: Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Turn the hand wheel (2) to open the valve.
Screw off nut (5-2).

Take out hand wheel (2) and take out key 
 (5-5).

Screw of nut (3-10) of bolts (3-7) which 
 connected yoke (3-3) with bonnet (4-1).

Turn the yoke (3-3) around stem (3-5) until 
 the yoke take out from stem.
Screws off the retaining screw (5-4).

Take out nut (5-3) which fixed yoke sleeve 
 (5-1) with yoke (3-3).
Take out yoke sleeve (5-1) from yoke (3-3).

Screw off the nuts (3-11) of gland bolts 
 (3-8).
Take out gland follower (3-2).

Screw off nut (4-3) of bolts (4-2) which 
 connected bonnet (4-1) with body (1).

Takes up stem (3-5) with wedge (3-1) and 
 bonnet (4-1).
Take out gasket (4-4) between bonnet and body.
Take out wedge (3-1) from stem (3-5).
Withdraw the stem (3-5) from bonnet (4-1).

Take out the gland packing (4-5) from stuffing 
 box, cooling push.

Screw of nuts of bolts for flange end for 
 flange type valve.

sections.text: Inspection and Repair of all Parts

If 
 the valve damaged, change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1

items:
Check the valves wedge (3-1) and regrind the 
 sealing surface of it if needed.

Check the valve seat rings (3-4) and regrind 
 it if needed. When grinding the seats of the movers, attention must be paid to 
 maintaining the angles of the sealing surfaces. In order to secure the mover 
 function it is not allowed to reduce the seat parts by more than 0.8 mm in 
 total (not more than 0.4 mm for one surface).

Repair the valve wedge (3-1) and valve seats 
 (3-4) in a specialist workshop if grinding can not repair the wear in there.

Check the stem (3-5) and repair it if needed 
 or replace it.

Check the yoke sleeve (5-1) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Check cooling ring.

Check the packing gland (3-2) and repair it if 
 needed or replace it.
Clean every connection face.
Change gasket (4-4).

Checks socket adapter (3) and replace it if 
 needed.

Check the body (1), bonnet (4-1) from any 
 cracks or wear by using penetration fluids and repair it if found by using 
 suitable filler material or its equivalent acc. to table (1).
Change gasket for flange end.

If 
 the valve damaged, change it w.r.t. the material as stated in table 1

sections.text: Clean every part well before any assembly.

Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.

items:
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly.

sections.text: Replace the Packing of Valve Gland

Clean the stuffing box chamber and the cover 
 well.
Lubricate the gland bolts and nuts.

Wire the suitable packing size on a part of shaft with 
 the same diameter of valve spindle.

Cut all packing rings along the shaft by using sharp 
 knife.

Fit the rings in the stuffing box chamber with the cut 
 turned 180 , starting at 9 clock.

Open and close the valve and be sure that the valve 
 operation is correct.

 operation is correct.
